changes.title: Up to $500 a month in free API credits for ChatGPT Pro and Business
changes.detail: Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim up to $500 per month in API credits by linking an API organization they own.

changes.title: GPT-6.1 Terra released at $1 input / $5 output
changes.detail: A fast, efficient mid-size model: $1 input, $0.05 cached input and $5 output per million tokens; batch at half price.

changes.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.6 Flash prices double on 1 January 2027
changes.detail: Input $0.75 → $1.50, output $3.75 → $7.50, cached input $0.075 → $0.15 per million tokens; cache storage $0.50 → $1.00 per million tokens per hour.

changes.title: Gemini 4 Argon prices double on 1 December 2026
changes.detail: Input $2 → $4, output $10 → $20, cached input $0.10 → $0.20 per million tokens; batch doubles too. Google had called the launch price introductory.

changes.title: 12-hour prompt caching, with cache writes at 2.5x input price
changes.detail: Shared instructions, tools and context can stay cached for 12 hours, so requests hours apart still get cached-input prices. Writing to the 12-hour cache costs 2.5x the input token price.
